title: Scenario
description: Wires a couple persona + guest personas + injected world events + success criteria into one runnable eval case. A run consumes exactly one scenario and emits one grade report.

scenario_type.description: golden = known-good regression anchor; adversarial = designed to break the product.

description.description: One line: the situation and what is being tested.

focus.description: Which North Star pillar(s) this scenario stresses. Drives coverage tracking.

world_state.description: The vendor/availability world the run operates against.

mode.description: 'fixture' = deterministic canned inventory (default for the loop); 'live_sandbox' = real integration sandboxes.

inventory_fixture_ref.description: Path to a vendor inventory fixture when mode=fixture.

available_integrations.description: Which 3rd-party categories are reachable in this run, e.g. ['venue_booking_api','catering_form','band_email_only'].

world_events.description: Disruptions injected during the run to test recovery. Fired at the named phase.

at_phase.description: Lifecycle phase at which the event fires.

gates_must_hold.description: Veto gates that must hold. A breach makes verdict=fail.

target_metrics.description: Quantitative thresholds expected for a good run.

metric_code.description: e.g. budget_variance_pct, rsvp_resolution_rate, couple_active_minutes_total, autonomy_rate, qa_accuracy_rate, decision_reversal_rate.

golden_expected_outcomes.description: For golden scenarios only: the known-good plan signature (booked categories, on-budget, all guests resolved). Used as a regression anchor.

graded_axes.description: Which LLM-judge rubrics apply to this scenario.
